blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Automotive and discrete plants chase three numbers — OEE, escapes and launch time. Sensor network, vision inspection and scheduling intelligence move all three simultaneously, while IATF traceability and IT/OT security raise the baseline every program must respect.

items: Body-shop and assembly sequencing by spreadsheet; changeover minutes bleed OEE.
Legacy lines uninstrumented; OEE components and energy per unit are estimates.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Decision Intelligence Systems, Decision Intelligence Systems, Intelligent Document Processing from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Line changeover sequencing, Vision inspection, Predictive maintenance) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — IATF 16949 among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Decision paths that run in milliseconds, with policy checks and full logging.
Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end: extraction, validation and downstream action.
See the work as it actually runs: event-log truth before you automate anything.
Changeover-aware sequences proposed to planners (changeover losses recovered)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Manufacturing & Industrial level this capability reads as: demand/supply scenarios and changeover-aware sequences proposed to planners (planner throughput up; OEE waiting losses down). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
